stage1_target_recovery.interpretation: Catastrophic focal target mismatch is rejected. C. sieboldii is not a captured-locus recovery outlier under the public Compositae1061 system.

east_asian_sequence_anchor.interpretation: Coding-sequence compatibility with the C. nipponicum genome-derived anchor is strong, but chromosome-coordinate transfer remains untested.

stage2_genome_reference_localization.boundary: Primary-reference placement must be followed by same-individual hap1/hap2 controls before among-reference placement differences are interpreted.

next_decision_rule: Do not call PUBLIC_TRANSFER_GREEN until Stage 2 primary-reference localization and within-individual haplotype controls show that the focal clean-locus placement result is stable enough for the intended estimand.
